claim: If CloudFormation quickly creates and deletes many test environments, AWS recommends that you do not create a separate ACM certificate for each environment, which would quickly exhaust your certificate quota; instead, create one wildcard certificate that covers all of the domain names that you use for testing.

evidence.quote: If you use CloudFormation to quickly create and delete multiple test environments, we recommend that you do not create a separate ACM certificate for each environment. Doing so will quickly exhaust your certificate quota.
evidence.title: Best practices

evidence.quote: Instead, create a wildcard certificate that covers all of the domain names that you are using for testing.
